column3: Close to the Hebrew; “lead me” is rendered “Make me walk.”
Close to the Hebrew; “worthlessness” is rendered “vanity,” and “preserve me alive” as “revive me.”
“Which [is] for your fear” is rendered “As that which produces reverence for You,” and “fulfill” as “Establish.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth,” and “I hope” as “I wait.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the broad place” is rendered “at liberty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sojournings” is rendered “pilgrimage.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have said” is rendered “I have promised.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your face” is rendered “Your favor.”
